summary: Ceragon Networks Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a five-year, $70 million agreement with a Tier-1 APAC mobile operator to supply transport solutions, services, and technologies for 4G/5G network expansion. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or special situation; this is a routine customer contract update. No deal terms or structural changes are involved. The filing is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer disclosing material commercial agreement.
